title: Progressive Bosses
description: This mod adds bosses, with boss progression similar to Terraria with Calamity! Very Boss and Grinding Heavy
body:
# General
(This is VERY EARLY)
Ever wanted to have grinding and boss progression similar to terraria calamity, but in Minecraft?
Here it is! Currently there is only 1 basic boss, with weapon drops, but MUCH more is planned to be added!  
Currently there are 3 classes;
- Melee:
Typical swords, may have swords with projectiles in the future.
- Range:
Just Bow and Crossbow Right Now.
- Blood Magic:
A whole NEW class, cast powerful magic, but you use your health to cast it...
## Magaly Attacks:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Will just wander around, spilling lava wherever it goes.

</details>



## Suggested mods to play with this;
- Just Enough Items (JEI)
- Polymorph
